The world No 4 won 7-5 6-1 against the 16-year-old from China to progress to the last 16 in Beijing. Gauff was serving to stay in the first set at 4-5 when Sun thought she had hit a winner, but the American had already raised her hand to stop the point as a light in the side panels around the court was flickering. Gauff took the next three points to hold for 5-5, and then dropped just one more game in the match. The 22-year-old tried to explain the situation on X, saying: "It was an unfortunate situation but it is out of my control. messages.text: Brundle on Bahrain GP software 'chaos' and how Sepang surface tricked teams

metadata.summary: The Bahrain GP in Malaysia was one of the crazier races I've seen in F1. Eventually, this collaboration of lateral thinking which ensured a Grand Prix took place on a great track we have missed in F1 for nine years, was a huge success.
metadata.content: Martin Brundle's verdict on Bahrain GP software 'chaos' and how track tricked Ferrari and McLaren into wrong tyre choice | F1 News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Opinion Martin Brundle's verdict on Bahrain GP software 'chaos' and how track tricked Ferrari and McLaren into wrong tyre choice Sky Sports F1's Martin Brundle delves into the talking points from the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia, assessing the chaos caused by a software glitch, a major tyre-choice drama, and Max Verstappen's return to the top step of the podium for Red Bull Martin Brundle Expert Analyst @MBrundleF1 Monday 5 October 2026 18:50, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Highlights of the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia at the Sepang International Circuit The Bahrain GP in Malaysia was one of the crazier races I've seen in F1. Eventually, this collaboration of lateral thinking which ensured a Grand Prix took place on a great track we have missed in F1 for nine years, was a huge success. I want to say straight away that I know from meeting numerous fans over the weekend, particularly at the airport on Monday morning, that a great many people suffered very long delays getting out of the venue and back to their bases. Road systems became gridlocked and transit buses blocked. While the event was necessarily hurriedly assembled, this was still disappointing, and I want to add my personal appreciation to those fans in Malaysia.
